jobs.title: Functional Consultant & Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation 
 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.
 Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.
 We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP.

 Your Mission 
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform.

 
 What We’re Really Looking For 
 The following key attributes ensure success in this role:
 Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth Mindset – You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Customer-First Mentality – You think beyond implementation — you care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

 
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills — you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 
 Benefits 
 High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

 Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

 Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

 Employee ownership – be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

 Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

 Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 What You'll Own
 Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

 Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

 Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

 Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

 Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation
 

 What We're Looking For
 Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

 Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

 AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

 Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
 

 Outcome
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
 Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised..
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Region Delivery)
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to join our Region Delivery team. You will own the delivery of new compute regions end to end — from hardware handover through acceptance testing to production readiness — coordinating across hardware, networking, capacity, and platform engineering teams under tight timelines.

 

Your responsibilities will include

  • Owning delivery of region and GPU cluster deployment projects from kickoff through production handover

  • Coordinating the capacity acceptance procedure: validating infrastructure availability, quota allocations, monitoring/alerting, and documented sign-off before a region goes to customers

  • Coordinating acceptance testing across engineering teams (compute, storage, networking, GPU) and clarifying test ownership between them

  • Acting as the real-time escalation point during live deployments — resolving blockers such as hardware failures, provisioning issues, or capacity conflicts by engaging the right on-call teams

  • Defining and maintaining clear contracts and responsibilities between the teams involved in delivery to reduce cross-team ambiguity and friction

  • Driving continuous improvement and automation of repetitive deployment and acceptance-testing work

  • Running structured, high-signal status communications so stakeholders always know where a deployment stands

 

We expect you to have:

  • Proven experience leading technical projects or engineering teams, ideally in infrastructure, cloud, or datacenter environments

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across many engineering teams simultaneously and drive alignment without formal authority

  • Calm, decisive communication under pressure, including during live incidents

  • Strong bias toward clear ownership and documentation over ad hoc firefighting

  • Fluent English

 

It would be a strong advantage if you have:

  • Experience with cloud/compute capacity management or GPU infrastructure

  • Background in large-scale datacenter rollouts

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture<

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us Since 2000,  ITA Logistics Group  has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms  LetMeShip  and  ParcelParcel , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service. 
 Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us. 

 Your mission As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration. 
 You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving. 
 You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners. 

 Your Key Responsibilities You own and continuously develop the roadmap for our Customer APIs across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next. 

 You drive the migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next, identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful. 

 You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges. 

 You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. 

 You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases. 

 You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics. 

 Once live, you take ownership of our Unified Financial Platform (UFP) and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development. 

 You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 What you need to succeed You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering. 

 You have experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations. 

 You have a solid understanding of APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
 

 You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences.
 

 You are confident in stakeholder management and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs.
 

 You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most.
 

 You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in Hamburg and Naarden.
 

 You are curious about AI tools and digital solutions and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows.
 

 Experience in logistics, parcel, or freight tech, particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus. 

 Familiarity with HubSpot or CRM integrations, as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 Why ITA Logistics Group? You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, Delivery (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager, Delivery to help turn product priorities into clear, well-organized work for our engineering and design teams.

 Working closely with our Product Lead, you will help define new features, prepare upcoming work, coordinate requirements, and track sprint progress. You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.

 This is a great opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines.

 Tasks

 
 Draft feature scopes, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the Product Lead.

 Help maintain and organize the product backlog.

 Prepare features and tasks for refinement and sprint planning.

 Coordinate requirements and open questions between product, engineering, and design.

 Track sprint status, delivery progress, dependencies, and blockers.

 Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes.

 Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings.

 Document product requirements, decisions, and changes.

 Gather the information needed for prioritization discussions.

 Contribute recommendations while the Product Lead retains final prioritization responsibility.

 Help improve the team’s product-development and delivery processes.

 Take on greater product ownership as your skills and experience develop.

 
 What success looks like within your first six months 

 
 Upcoming features and tasks are documented clearly and prepared on time.

 Sprint progress, dependencies, and blockers are visible to the team.

 Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented.

 Engineering and design know where to find the information they need.

 Open questions are identified and brought to the right people early.

 The Product Lead has reliable support across planning, prioritization, and delivery.

 You begin handling smaller features with increasing independence.

 
 Requirements

 
 Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in product management, project coordination, business analysis, software delivery, design, QA, or a related area. Relevant internships and working-student experience may count.

 Some experience working with software engineering, design, or other multidisciplinary teams.

 The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items.

 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

 Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication.

 Confidence in following up on open questions, dependencies, and commitments.

 Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built.

 A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn.

 Basic familiarity with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence.

 
 Helpful, but not required 

 
 Experience writing user stories or acceptance criteria.

 Familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, or software-release processes.

 Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.

 Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or another quickly changing environment.

 
 You do not need to meet every item on this list. We care about your potential, judgment, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

 Benefits

 We offer an exciting environment at the intersection of technology, entertainment, and marketing as part of an ambitious, international, and results-oriented startup team.

 
 Work with an excellent international team on varied tasks with extensive opportunities to learn and grow.

 An attractive and competitive salary.

 A monthly learning budget.

 Support for an Urban Sports Club membership.

 Support for your preferred means of transport—we help finance your new bike or public transport subscription.

 A startup office in one of Berlin’s cultural hubs, where you’ll never get bored.

 
 We welcome applicants with different backgrounds and experiences. If the role interests you but you do not meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:

We own the systems that determine whether a merchant's identity is verified, whether that verification meets the regulatory bar in every market we operate in, and whether the decisions made along the way are auditable and defensible.   • Co-lead the squad alongside a strong Engineering Manager, driving platform modernisation and reducing technical debt deliberately

You'll be great for this role if

  • Proven experience as a product manager in a regulated fintech or financial services environment, with direct ownership of KYC, KYB, or identity verification products across multiple markets

  • Strong ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder environments — including Legal, AML, Compliance, Risk, and Operations — negotiating scope with credibility and care, and holding the line when it matters

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer (YouTrack)
jobs.description:
You see software development and team organization not as a rigid set of rules, but as a craft that deserves better tools. You want to design complex, data-rich productivity platforms where information architecture is a first-class problem, and you want to rethink how humans work alongside AI. If you are a designer who values hands-on craft, hates unnecessary bureaucracy, and wants the autonomy to build a team's design process from scratch, this role was built for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 companies rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

YouTrack handles serious complexity – agile boards, backlogs, knowledge bases, helpdesks, and deeply customizable workflows – across teams from two-person startups to global enterprises. We’re at a point where the category's oldest assumptions are worth reconsidering. Issue tracking has relied on the same foundational blocks for years, but AI opens an opportunity to rethink how software can actively help teams get work done.

We need a Lead Product Designer to shape where project management goes next while keeping a massive, mature surface area coherent, legible, and a pleasant to use. In this role, you’ll lead a small design team of two designers, own the overall design quality bar across the product, and act as an individual contributor on our hardest, least-charted problems. You’ll build a fresh design process from scratch with the full backing of a team lead who respects craft and values professional judgment.

Day to day, you will:

  • Shape a point of view on how project management and issue tracking evolve in an AI-native world and turn those concepts into tools people can actually use.
  • Design how people work alongside AI capabilities in YouTrack, from conversational interfaces to inline assistance and background automation.
  • Develop interaction patterns for unsettled problems, including surfacing AI confidence, making actions transparent, and keeping users in control.
  • Prototype and test new concepts quickly, separating ideas that feel clever from those that genuinely reduce friction.
  • Keep a large, deep product coherent so that boards, helpdesks, reports, and administration feel like a single cohesive engine.
  • Partner with product management and engineering to shape roadmap priorities from a design perspective, influencing what gets built and why.

What you’ll bring

  • A deep commitment to craft ownership, holding yourself and your team to high standards without creating bottlenecks.
  • Comfort building clear, lightweight processes, without turning them into restrictive bureaucracy.
  • The generosity to share knowledge openly and collaborate across a broad, global design community.
  • Clarity in your writing and reasoning, with the ability to explain complex design decisions in plain words.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy appetite for finding the right questions before designing the answers.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held, with a clear understanding of when to follow platform conventions and when to break them.

What you’ll need

  • Successfully led the design of complex, data-rich productivity tools or software systems where information architecture is a primary challenge.
  • Proven understanding of how modern AI systems operate beyond single-turn prompts, including agentic workflows and multi-step execution.
  • Experience mentoring and leading other designers, giving clear feedback that lands and raises the bar.
  • Ability to design unified experiences that cater to small startup teams and large enterprise customers simultaneously.
  • A portfolio showing a range of work from precise micro-interactions to large-scale information architecture.

What success looks like

Success means earning the trust of your team and peers through sound interaction choices and clear systemic improvements. You will establish a reliable critique rhythm and a structured way of working that helps your designers grow. Within your first few months, delivering clear patterns for our AI capabilities, paying down accumulated UX debt, and ensuring YouTrack remains both deep and remarkably quick on its feet.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge,

jobs.title: Senior Construction Project Manager
jobs.description:
Elgin Values Core behavioural responsibilities for all employees   Agility  We Lead with Agility   Integrity  We Act with Integrity Excellence  We Empower Excellence Care We Value Care

 Job Description Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders? 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

 What you will be do: 
 Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.
 Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions.
 Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations.
 Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
 Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
 Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
 Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
 Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
 Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
 Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.

 Degree in project management, construction management, engineering, or similar.
 Extensive experience in infrastructure, renewables, power, energy storage or comparable capital projects, with significant project and contract management responsibility.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Who We Are

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

You will work with data engineering, data scientists, analytics, customer success and the retailers themselves. What you build are data products, and the measure of one is what a retailer does differently because of it.

This is a hands-on role. You will set direction and priorities as we roll out to hundreds of new stores, but you are also expected to know the systems well enough to be a partner in an engineering design conversation, pull your own numbers when something looks wrong, and hold a strong position in the discussions with customers.

  • You can change your mind in a technical argument, and you can point to the time you did
  • You have strong judgment about what not to build, and you have killed your own work when it stopped earning its place

jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben Du gestaltest E-Commerce-Erlebnisse, die Kunden begeistern und die Conversion messbar verbessern? Du denkst in durchgängigen User Journeys, hast einen scharfen Blick für UX/UI-Details und suchst eine Rolle mit voller Ownership für den Shop? 
 Dann suchst du genau uns – und wir dich! Als unser/e  E-Commerce Product Owner:in  bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt/Dev ,  Operations und Marketing. Du baust Features, die Kunden weiterbringen und die Conversion messbar heben – und machst unseren Shop damit zum Maßstab in seiner Klasse. 
 Deine Mission  Full Ownership & UX/UI-Exzellenz:  Du bist die treibende Kraft hinter unserem Webshop. Du ownsed die Produkt-Roadmap, steuerst die Features nach Business-Impact und sorgst für ein nahtloses, kundenfreundliches UI/UX-Erlebnis auf allen Devices. 

 Conversion- & Journey-Optimierung:  Du drehst an den richtigen Stellschrauben über den gesamten Funnel hinweg, von der Suche über die PDP (Product Detail Page) bis zum Checkout. 

 Data-Driven Growth:  GA4, BI und A/B-Tests sind deine Spielwiese. Du übernimmst die KPI-Verantwortung (CVR, AOV, Warenkorbabbrüche, RPV) und leitest daraus konkrete Hypothesen und Experimente ab. 

 Smart Features & Ökosysteme:  Du entwickelst kundenfreundliche Kompatibilitäts-Filter (Matter, Apple Home, Alexa etc.) sowie intelligente Starter-Set- und Bundle-Mechaniken, die Erklärungsbedarf reduzieren und den Warenkorbwert steigern. 

 Next-Level AI-Shopping:  Du verantwortest innovative KI-Features - von Guided Selling über semantische Suchen bis hin zum Conversational Smart-Home-Assistant. 

 Agile Schnittstelle:  Du übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse und Business-Ziele in klare Requirements für unser Tech-, Design- und Marketing-Team und stellst die höchste Qualität bei jedem Release sicher. 

 

 Dein Profil E-Commerce DNA:  Mehrjährige Erfahrung im transaktionalen E-Commerce mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen bei der CVR- und Funnel-Optimierung (Du lieferst Kennzahlen, nicht nur Features!). 

 Deep Tech- & Analytics-Verständnis:  Sicheres Händchen für Web-Analytics (GA4, Tracking-Konzepte, Dashboards), Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie fundiertes Verständnis von modernen E-Commerce-Architekturen (Shopware, Magento, commercetools oder Headless/APIs). 

 Kommerzieller Drive:  Du denkst in Deckungsbeiträgen sowie Unit Economics und priorisierst Feature-Requests knallhart nach P&L-Impact. 

 UX/UI & Qualitätssinn:  Du hast ein hervorragendes Auge für intuitive Benutzerführung und den Anspruch, nur absolut makellose, kundenfreundliche Web-Anwendungen live zu bringen. 

 AI-First Mindset:  Du nutzt KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich in deinem täglichen Workflow, um Analysen, Specs oder Experimente extrem schnell auf das nächste Level zu heben. 
 Sprachkenntnisse : Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und hervorragende Englischkenntnisse. 
 Office-First & Team-Vibes: Du liebst den persönlichen Austausch, schätzt schnelle Kommunikationswege und hast richtig Lust, jeden Tag gemeinsam mit deinem Team in unserem wunderschönen Office im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte zu arbeiten.
 Nice-to-haves: 
 Erfahrung im Umfeld erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte (Consumer Electronics, Technik oder Smart Home). 

 Verständnis für Smart-Home-Standards und Plattform-Ökosysteme. 

 Gespür für Merchandising, Pricing-Schnittstellen und Margenlogik bei Sets/Bundles.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

 Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

 What You'll Be Doing 

 You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 
 Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

 Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

 Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

 Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

 
 What You'll Need to Thrive 

 Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

 
 Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

 You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

 You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

 You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

 You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

 You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

 
 Next steps

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 What You'll Own
 Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

 Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

 Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

 Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

 Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation
 

 What We're Looking For
 Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

 Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

 AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

 Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
 

 Outcome
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 Location

 Language

 Interview Process

jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation 
 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.
 Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.
 We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP.

 Your Mission 
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform.

 
 What We’re Really Looking For 
 The following key attributes ensure success in this role:
 Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth Mindset – You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Customer-First Mentality – You think beyond implementation — you care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

 
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills — you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 
 Benefits 
 High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

 Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

 Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

 Employee ownership – be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

 Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

 Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

 Your Responsibilities As Director Product Marketing, you will shape the positioning and go-to-market strategy for Jedox product offerings. With a hands-on approach and strong ownership mindset, you will lead cross-functional product launches, refine company positioning, enable the sales organization, and communicate the value of Jedox solutions throughout the customer buying journey. 
 What You’ll Do Lead cross-functional product launches:  Develop and execute multi-channel launch plans for new Jedox product offerings, ensuring effective internal readiness and strong external market activation. 
 Shape positioning and thought leadership:  Lead and support the development of company and product positioning, informed by market research, analysis, and relevant industry perspectives.

 Enable sales success: Create high-quality sales collateral that equips the global sales organization to communicate Jedox’s value consistently and effectively.

 Drive analyst and influencer engagement:  Identify priority analysts and influencers, relevant upcoming research, and published reports to maximize opportunities for meaningful engagement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. 

 This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 

 MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. 

 AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. 

 You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. 

 The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. 
 

 About MoonPay Enterprise

 MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

 KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.

 What You'll Own

 KYB product strategy & roadmap

 
 
 Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.

 
 Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.

 
 MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.

 
 Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.

 
 Onboarding funnel & conversion

 
 
 The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.

 
 Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.

 
 Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.

 
 KYB API & partner experience

 
 
 The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).

 
 Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.

 
 Compliance as product

 
 
 Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.

 
 EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.

 
 Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.

More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo. 

The Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to join our Reference Data team, based in Edinburgh.

Reference Data is part of the Data Enablement team at Addepar. Our mission is to build a scalable, efficient, and high quality data platform that integrates, connects, productionises, and distributes third-party data content across Addepar and to our clients and partners.

Our team is organised across two product tracks — Market Data Feeds and Addepar Security Master (ASM). This role will power these tracks. You will be working on projects that focus on turning raw data into the clear, well-structured insights that help our team make better decisions, move faster, and deliver more confidently across feeds, security mastering, and commercial reporting.

This role requires deep data skills, rigorous thinking, and the ability to approach tasks with a builder mindset. 

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Work on a series of projects that will serve as the analytical foundation across the team, running the data investigations, ad hoc queries, and structured analyses that inform our prioritisation, requirements, and decisions.
  • Drive data quality analysis layer for Market Data Feed builds and our security master: profiling incoming vendor data, validating transformations, identifying anomalies and coverage gaps.
  • Build and maintain the reporting infrastructure that gives the team and leadership visibility into dataset profitability, vendor licensing costs vs. revenue, pipeline health, feed coverage, and commercial activity. 
  • Query across our data systems to produce views and dashboarding on profitability by dataset, spend vs. budget, commercial pipeline tracking.
  • Support ASM operational workflows through data by generating output that help us such as running reconciliation queries, validating node matching and security ID linking, and surfacing data quality issues that require attention by our team.
  • Productising our ability to monitor market data pipelines and operational dashboards, triaging feed errors and flagging issues to operations and/or R&D with enough context to act.
  • Actively using and applying AI-assisted tools to accelerate Refdata product outcomes.
  • Maintain and upkeep our licensing inventory including dashboards that track spend against budget, renewal timelines, and licensing events and keep those views accurate and accessible to a wide audience.

Who You Are

  • Prior experience as a data analyst, business analyst, or product analyst ideally in financial services or a data-intensive SaaS environment where data quality and rigour matter.
  • Strong SQL skills -  you can write complex queries confidently and use them as a primary tool for investigation, not just reporting.
  • Experienced with AI-assisted tools to facilitate getting work done, particularly applying them to real analytical tasks tied to business outcomes.
  • Experience with Python for data work: analysis, scripting, and automation; comfortable with pandas, Jupyter, or similar tools.
  • Able to build reporting that spans multiple data sources with knowledge on how to join pieces of information like Salesforce data with finance data and operational data and produce something coherent and trustworthy.
  • Ideal if knowledgeable in financial data concepts such as asset class and security level concepts, reference data, and pricing or the desire to learn more about these concepts.
  • A builder and self-starter that is dependable in your work. Teammates trust what you produce.
  • A clear communicator who can write up findings, document processes, and present analysis to diverse audiences.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
